title: Reduce unrestricted feasibility to one target-free improving circuit from a known compact vertex
statement: P(A,b)={(u,t,w)>=0:Au-bt=0,1^Tu+t+w=1} is compact and has known vertex v0=(0,0,1), objective-t. Original Ax=b,x>=0 is feasible iff a feasible strictly improving circuit exists at v0. Any returned circuit q has q_u>=0,q_t>0,Aq_u=bq_t, giving x=q_u/q_t. Conversely conformal decomposition of (x,1,0)/(1+1^Tx)-v0 contains an improving circuit with finite maximal step.
